open_issues: The newest Foundation Foods CSV (FoodData_Central_foundation_food_csv_2026-10-29.zip, 200, 1.1 MB) ships without food.csv, food_nutrient.csv and food_portion.csv; the 2026-04-30 release was used. Recheck the October release later.

Only 8 of the curated foods use Foundation data: most Foundation foods lack total sugars (nutrient 2000 missing on 390 of 395, 1063 on 246) or fiber (197 missing), so SR Legacy (2018) is primary. 7 Foundation-only candidates (almond flour, coconut flour, steel cut oats, farro, red onion, napa cabbage, oat milk) were dropped rather than proxied.

37 foods have one or more nutrients USDA leaves blank (mostly sugars for some spices, grains and oils); results list them under nutrients_not_reported_by_usda and totals are a lower bound for that nutrient.
Nutrition is for raw ingredients as listed; no cooking yield or retention factors. Added sugars are not in SR Legacy (round_nutrition_label takes them as input).
Ingredient matching is heuristic (token + trigram); spot-checked on ~60 typical lines, not exhaustively. Lines below the match threshold are reported as unresolved, never guessed.
%DV is computed from the unrounded amount; the eCFR text read this session does not say rounded vs unrounded.
Scout flagged this as the weakest 'model cannot do it alone' case; value is exact USDA lookups, food-specific household weights and FDA rounding.
